title: Conveyor Operators and Tenders
description: Control or tend conveyors or conveyor systems that move materials or products to and from stockpiles, processing stations, departments, or vehicles. May control speed and routing of materials or products.

tasks.text: Stop equipment or machinery and clear jams, using poles, bars, and hand tools, or remove damaged materials from conveyors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control of conveyors and material movers

dwas.name: Remove debris or damaged materials.
Operate conveyors or other industrial material moving equipment.

tasks.text: Load, unload, or adjust materials or products on conveyors by hand, by using lifts, hoists, and scoops, or by opening gates, chutes, or hoppers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on loading of processing equipment

dwas.name: Load materials into equipment for processing.

tasks.text: Observe conveyor operations and monitor lights, dials, and gauges to maintain specified operating levels and to detect equipment malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Gauge reading requires physical presence

dwas.name: Monitor equipment gauges or displays to ensure proper operation.
Inspect material-moving equipment to detect problems.

tasks.text: Observe packages moving along conveyors to identify packages, detect defective packaging, and perform quality control.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI flags quality/safety issues; human owns physical verification

dwas.name: Monitor operational quality or safety.

tasks.text: Position deflector bars, gates, chutes, or spouts to divert flow of materials from one conveyor onto another conveyor.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Positioning material handling equipment is physical

dwas.name: Position material handling equipment.

tasks.text: Clean, sterilize, and maintain equipment, machinery, and work stations, using hand tools, shovels, brooms, chemicals, hoses, and lubricants.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Machinery cleaning requires hands-on work

dwas.name: Clean facilities or work areas.
Clean machinery or equipment.
Maintain material moving equipment in good working condition.

tasks.text: Record production data such as weights, types, quantities, and storage locations of materials, as well as equipment performance problems and downtime.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Inform supervisors of equipment malfunctions that need to be addressed.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reporting malfunctions is structured information relay

dwas.name: Report vehicle or equipment malfunctions.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Manipulate controls, levers, and valves to start pumps, auxiliary equipment, or conveyors, and to adjust equipment positions, speeds, timing, and material flows.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control of conveyors and material movers

dwas.name: Control pumps or pumping equipment.
Operate conveyors or other industrial material moving equipment.

tasks.text: Distribute materials, supplies, and equipment to work stations, using lifts and trucks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual moving of materials and supplies

dwas.name: Move materials, equipment, or supplies.

tasks.text: Press console buttons to deflect packages to predetermined accumulators or reject lines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical operation of packing/material processing machinery

dwas.name: Operate packing or other material processing equipment.

tasks.text: Thread strapping through strapping tools and secure battens with strapping to form protective pallets around extrusions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical securing of cargo with straps

dwas.name: Secure cargo.

tasks.text: Operate elevator systems in conjunction with conveyor systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control of conveyors and material movers

dwas.name: Operate conveyors or other industrial material moving equipment.
Operate industrial equipment.

tasks.text: Weigh or measure materials and products, using scales or other measuring instruments, or read scales on conveyors that continually weigh products, to verify specified tonnages and prevent overloads.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of material

dwas.name: Measure product or material dimensions.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Weigh materials to ensure compliance with specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Read production and delivery schedules, and confer with supervisors, to determine sorting and transfer procedures, arrangement of packages on pallets, and destinations of loaded pallets.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse work orders into procedures reliably

dwas.name: Review work orders or schedules to determine operations or procedures.
Communicate with others to coordinate material handling or movement.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Operate consoles to control automatic palletizing equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on control of industrial machinery in unstructured settings

dwas.name: Operate industrial equipment.
Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Contact workers in work stations or other departments to request movement of materials, products, or machinery, or to notify them of incoming shipments and their estimated delivery times.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Material-handling coordination tied to physical operations

dwas.name: Communicate with others to coordinate material handling or movement.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Affix identifying information to materials or products, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically marking objects requires manipulation

dwas.name: Mark materials or objects for identification.

tasks.text: Collect samples of materials or products, checking them to ensure conformance to specifications or sending them to laboratories for analysis.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Testing samples requires lab hands-on work

dwas.name: Test materials, solutions, or samples.
Collect samples for analysis or testing.

tasks.text: Move, assemble, and connect hoses or nozzles to material hoppers, storage tanks, conveyor sections or chutes, and pumps.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting hoses requires physical fitting

dwas.name: Move materials, equipment, or supplies.
Install parts, assemblies, or attachments in transportation or material handling equipment.
Connect hoses to equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Repair or replace equipment components or parts such as blades, rolls, and pumps.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of material moving equipment

dwas.name: Maintain material moving equipment in good working condition.

tasks.text: Measure dimensions of bundles, using rulers, and cut battens to required sizes, using power saws.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure distances or dimensions.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Cut materials according to specifications or needs.
Operate cutting equipment.

tasks.text: Join sections of conveyor frames at temporary working areas, and connect power units.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting cables is hands-on installation

dwas.name: Install parts, assemblies, or attachments in transportation or material handling equipment.
Connect cables or electrical lines.
